maddeler.e:
تشجوا (form I)
# تَشُجُّوا (tašujjū) /ta.ʃud͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
# تَشِجُّوا (tašijjū) /ta.ʃid͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
# تُشَجُّوا (tušajjū) /tu.ʃad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
